title: CLM webhook event (POST /services/apexrest/q2c/clm/v1/events)
description: Signed with X-CLM-Timestamp + X-CLM-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp.body). eventId is unique per event and is the dedupe key. agreementVersion increases with every agreement change and orders out-of-order deliveries. Unknown types are accepted and ignored.
